statement: SK Hynix holds 56.4% of the HBM market, making high-bandwidth memory supply structurally concentrated in one vendor.
why: When one supplier holds a majority of HBM output, accelerator makers' build plans depend on that vendor's capacity and pricing decisions.

impact.mechanism: Majority share in a bottleneck component gives one supplier pricing and allocation power, constraining the effective supply available to GPU builders.

confidence.basis: Secondary open-web analyst article; no primary filing and no corroboration across three distinct publishers in this document.
